title: Select [IN]
description:
## IN
Instead of writing multiple OR conditions:
```sql
SELECT * FROM users
WHERE name = 'tom' OR name = 'paul' OR name = 'steve';
```
You can use `IN`:
```sql
SELECT * FROM users
WHERE name IN('tom', 'paul', 'steve');
```
Same result, way cleaner. You can also use `NOT IN` to exclude values.


---
## Assignment:
BWS needs to find all servers that have status 'running' or 'on fire'. Use IN.
setupCode: CREATE TABLE servers (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, cpu_cores INTEGER, status TEXT); INSERT INTO servers VALUES (1, 'prod-1', 8, 'running'), (2, 'prod-2', 16, 'running'), (3, 'staging-1', 4, 'stopped'), (4, 'dev-box', 2, 'on fire'), (5, 'mystery-box', 8, 'pending');
